verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's evidence covers GPU marketplace mechanics (search, rent, billing, templates, serverless, agent skill for driving the platform) but nothing about the product itself generating AI-driven insights or suggestions from a user's own data (e.g., usage analytics, cost/workload recommendations surfaced in-product). The 'agent skill' lets external AI assistants control Vast.ai, which is a different capability (agentic control, not data-derived insight generation).
